title: The K menu
summary: The SkyRPG menu: every page in it, what it shows and what you can do there.

s.x: and one window opens with everything the pack adds: your character, skills, quests, pets, collections and settings. It has a sidebar of pages on the left and a dark custom look instead of vanilla screens. This page lists every page, in the order they appear.

rows.x: Open the menu, on the page you last used. Press again to close.
Step back inside a page, for example clear a search. Closes the menu when there is nowhere left to go back.
Jump to one of the first nine pages
Click a page in the sidebar

s.x: A page with a text field, such as Pay, Party or Settings, takes digits and letters first.
The window fits itself to your screen.
